title: docs(adr): ADR-0158 units of measure records ruling U1–U8; L1, L2 and L4 pending
body:
Fixes #35339
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；这是一份设计记录，把您同意的计量单位方案（标准单位表、各组织自加的单位、带单位的数量字段、分两期交付）按原话写成合同，后面的实现卡照它做。
- 为什么做：来自「平台计量单位」这张卡；各套件各写一套单位，数量在套件之间、和 ERP 之间对不上，箱和个、千克和吨也没法换算。
- 出错会怎样：只影响后续实现卡的依据，不改任何运行行为；写错了撤回或改这份记录即可。
- 要你做什么：无；记录里还有两处待定（自定义单位的换算比例用过后能不能改、自定义单位的名称要不要多语言），席位会单独请您定，补齐后再请您审阅合入。

## 席位核对

### What changes
- New `docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md`, Status **Accepted** by ruling record 7001193034 on #35339, header modelled on ADR-0144's. Decision quotes U1 to U8 verbatim with the ruling's own labels; Non-goals quotes "Out of scope". It declares and implements nothing.
- "Left to this record" has four sections. Each PENDING one carries an HTML-comment marker reading `PENDING: settlement from the seat` and states only the question as ruled.
  - **L1, PENDING**: whether an organization unit's ratio locks once used, and how (with the maintainer).
  - **L2, PENDING**: how organization-unit labels are translated (with the maintainer).
  - **L3, settled** by the owning seat as a technical item: `unitConfig: { unitMode, unit, unitField, unitDimension }`, `unitMode` required with no default, `unit` not `defaultUnit`, `unitDimension` not `dimension`; following a parent through `master_detail` is not admitted and its spelling is reserved. With it: two consequences under U3 (members can read `sys_unit`; it is labelled "unit of measure") and Open item 5 (the suite-supplied `factorField` input and the engine-written factor output get different names).
  - **L4, settled** by the owning seat as a technical item, quoted as the seat's text: the field's `scale` governs storage and is the ceiling; a unit's decimal places (U6) are only its display default and never exceed it; nothing is rounded at write by a unit's decimal places; in R2 the projected base quantity rounds to the base field's `scale`. The open item on R2 rounding leaves the list, and one Consequences line states the rule.
- `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` (generator-owned): the new row, the summary counts, and ADR-0137's row, which was stale on `main`.
- Number **0158**, not 0157: #35364 (working calendars, opened 06:23Z) holds 0157 as an open PR at write time.

### Tests
No code. Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this diff, run at head `571f5710`: 21 of 21 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every line carrying its exit code). The first sweep, at `46715bc4`, read the same 21 of 21.

<details><summary>Gate verdict lines</summary>

- `check-adr-links`: 1171 relative link destination(s) under docs/adr/ resolve
- `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 3800 anchors across 159 records resolve, 0 line anchors. Control leg (at `46715bc4`): one anchor in this record mutated to a symbol that does not exist reds the gate (exit 1, `unresolved-symbol` on this file); restored from `HEAD`, hash equal to `HEAD`'s blob.
- `check:adr-index`: docs/adr/README.md is current, every record parsed
- `check:adr-anchors`: OK, 153 decision numbers each naming one decision
- `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:closed-ceremony-text` and the rest of the 21: exit 0
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 on the first sweep (prerequisite: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built; nothing measured), then exit 0 after building those two under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).

</details>

<details><summary>Verbatim check of the quotations</summary>

A script compared every quoted line of ruling record 7001193034 (the maintainer quote, the three accepted answers, U1 to U8 with U4's and U7's sub-bullets, "Out of scope", "Left to the ADR", "Next") with the ADR text, blockquote markers and line wraps collapsed: 33 of 33 present at `571f5710`. Control: the same script over a copy with one hyphen removed from U2 reports that line missing. The seat's L4 text is present byte for byte.

</details>

<details><summary>CI reading for head 46715bc4: cancelled, not red</summary>

`Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` failed on run 44474188492 only as aggregators: their first errors read "lint lane `lint-ci-engine` concluded `cancelled` -- expected `success`" and "type-check lane `typecheck-consumers` concluded `cancelled` -- expected `success`", four lanes each, and no lane concluded `failure`. `lint.yml` sets `concurrency` per PR with `cancel-in-progress: true`; the push of `571f5710` started run 44474653010 at 06:46:40Z, and every lane of the older run was cancelled between 06:46:44Z and 06:46:59Z. Nothing was pushed for it. The run at `571f5710` is the one to read.

</details>

### Acceptance notes
- A1, measured: `origin/main` `3819afec` ended at 0156, and none of 48 open PRs touched `docs/adr/` (control: #34464's file list returns its ADR path). Re-read at write time: #35364 adds 0157, so this record is 0158. Re-read again at `571f5710`: `origin/main` `c05a8a01` still ends at 0156, and of 51 open PRs only #35364 (0157) and this one (0158) add an ADR.
- A2, holds in part: the README keeps one row per ADR, but it is generated by `scripts/adr-index.mjs`, never hand-edited. Its gate `check:adr-index` is report-only: it warns on a stale index and reds only on a dropped Date, Supersedes or Superseded-by field.
- A3, holds: `dispatch-gates --commands` derives the ADR families (adr-links, adr-anchors, adr-index, adr-symbol-anchors) among its 21.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exits 1 against #35364 on `docs/adr/README.md` only: both append an index row and bump the same counts. Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-runs `pnpm adr:index`.
- The title avoids `sys_unit`: `scripts/adr-index.mjs` strips every underscore from a title, so an identifier in a title is published wrong in the index (on `main` today: `sysmetadata`, `statemachine`, `syspermissionset`, `SCREAMINGSNAKE`). Reported to the seat as a finding; not fixed here.
- The suite facts in Context (hotcrm order lines, hotsrm free-text units, the production suite) are the card's readings, quoted as such; the suites' source was not read.

### Verification
Read first: the ADR's "Left to this record" (L3 and L4 are settled, and both are the seat's text, not the ruling's); then Decision, each U against ruling record 7001193034; then the new README row.

Two-minute check: open the ADR and search for `PENDING: settlement from the seat`; expect exactly two hits, under L1 and L2.

Governed (Tier H): stays draft; landing is the maintainer's.
